name: Whitechapel
locality: London Borough of Tower Hamlets, Tower division
text: Whitechapel is an area in the London Borough of Tower Hamlets, London, England. It is in East London and part of the East End. It is the location of Tower Hamlets Town Hall and the borough town centre.

depictions.name: Whitechapel
depictions.text: Whitechapel is one of London's seven boroughs. During the Industrial Revolution, the region became a place of destitution, with its inhabitants often turning to begging, thievery, murder, and prostitution.
